# AI Evaluation & Quality Engineering — Exercise Sheets

Work in tables of 3–4. Each lab ends with something written down that you take back to work.

## Lab 1 — Why 'it feels better' fails

*Module 1: Why 'it feels better' fails · about 24 minutes*

**With demo 1** (`python demos/01_feels_better_fails.py`): Think of the last change you shipped because 'it looked better'. Which three questions did you try? Write the five you did not.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 2 — 50-query set

*Module 2: Golden sets · about 48 minutes*

**With demo 2** (`python demos/02_build_golden_set.py`): Draft your 50-query set: 60% typical, 15% paraphrase, 10% multi-document, 10% out-of-scope, 5% adversarial. Have a second person label ten. Compute agreement.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 3 — Score a system

*Module 3: Metrics · about 48 minutes*

**With demo 3** (`python demos/03_score_a_system.py`): Score your own system on ten queries by hand first, then with code. Where do the numbers disagree with your gut? That gap is the point of the exercise.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 4 — Calibrate a judge

*Module 4: LLM-as-judge · about 48 minutes*

**With demo 4** (`python demos/04_calibrate_a_judge.py`): Write a four-line rubric for your domain. Label 20 answers yourself first, THEN run the judge. If kappa is under 0.6, fix the rubric, not the labels.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 5 — CI gate

*Module 5: Evals in the lifecycle · about 24 minutes*

**With demo 5** (`python demos/05_ci_gate_and_production_sampling.py`): Write your gate: three floors and one regression rule. Decide your weekly production sample size from the interval you need.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.
